plotSections.title: Sight and sound restored
bullets: Ord’s dispel magic removes the effect blocking the party’s ability to see and hear.
Everyone aboard can see and hear again, including the confused crew.
The spectral door remains floating in the sky, but the party still cannot use it.
The party praises Ord for ending the effect.

plotSections.title: Head count on the flying boat
bullets: Sylan calls for a head count to make sure no one fell off during the muted invisible episode.
All four named crew members are found aboard and none jumped or fell off.
Ciri is hiding behind the mast or a barrel and is eventually accounted for.
Walker is not on the boat; he is away on his separate Sunder excursion.
Mikkel the spymaster is not aboard, continuing the running problem of the party leaving without him.

plotSections.title: Aftermath of Gerk’s doorway
bullets: Sylan says Gerk caused the situation and they need to figure out what happened to him.
Gerk keeps his distance from Sylan and asks Ord to stand nearby instead.
The party agrees not to open doors on moving things again.
Gerk retests the spectral door and confirms it still does nothing.

plotSections.title: Moving on
bullets: Sylan gives Dana about thirty minutes to investigate the spectral door if she wants.
If Dana does not care to study it, the party plans to leave the floating portal behind and continue the journey.
The group discusses giving Mikkel better ways to rejoin the boat, such as a sending stone or teleportation tunnel.

chronologicalEvents: Ord’s dispel magic restores sight and sound for the party and crew.
Gerk asks whether the spectral door disappeared; it remains unusable in the sky.
The party congratulates Ord and jokes about him being covered in oil.
Sylan calls for a head count while the boat is still in flight.
All four crew members are found safe aboard.
Ciri is located hiding behind the mast or a barrel.
Sylan confirms Mikkel is not aboard the boat.
Sylan says Gerk caused the incident and they need to understand what happened.
Sylan offers Dana thirty minutes to investigate the spectral door.
The party agrees to leave the portal behind and continue unless Dana finds reason to stay.

notes: His dispel magic successfully ends the party’s invisibility and silence.
Remains covered in oil from his dragon vessel.
Gerk asks him to stand nearby instead of Sylan while tempers settle.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian Doorman and Child of the Great Eldarin Tree.
notes: Is blamed for causing the doorway incident on the moving boat.
Retests the spectral door and confirms it still does nothing.
Accepts the lesson not to open doors on moving things.
Suggests giving Mikkel a teleportation tunnel or other way back to the boat.
Organizes a head count after sight and sound return.
Finds all four crew members but not Mikkel.
Gives Dana thirty minutes to investigate the spectral door if she wants.
Plans to leave the floating portal behind and continue travel.
Sylan gives her about thirty minutes to investigate the spectral door because she may be the only one who can understand it.
Hides behind the mast or a barrel during the head count.
Is eventually accounted for on the boat.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Is not on the boat during the head count; he is away on his Sunder side trip.

Spectral Door.existing: A mysterious spectral door resembling Gerk's shield form.
notes: Remains floating in the sky after the dispel.
Still cannot be used as a functional door.
Dana is offered time to investigate it before the party moves on.
Spymaster associated with the crew.
Is not aboard the boat again when the party checks.
The party has a recurring problem of departing without verifying he is onboard.

Abel.existing: Surviving-and-revived crew member and the boat's helmsman.
notes: Is confirmed safe aboard with the other crew after the dispel.

Doorway.existing: A fixed supernatural passage between locations.
notes: Opening a doorway on the moving boat caused the invisibility and silence effect.
The party agrees not to open doors on moving things again.

misTranscriptions.notes: Gerk praising the paladin after the dispel.
Why the party cannot leave the boat.
Gerk joking about sharing a chaos god.

openQuestions: What exactly happened to Gerk when he opened the door?

newTerms.name: Mikkel
notes: Crew spymaster who is frequently left behind when the boat departs.
